verses.text: Ayik ix yilan heb' winh oxwanh chi' to stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Job yalani to malaj smul winh, ix yaktan heb' winh stelan sb'a yet' winh.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh ay jun winh winak aj chonhab' Buz, Eliú sb'i winh, yuninal winh winhaj Baraquel yinhtilal winhaj Ram. Majxo techaj yuj winh skot yowal t'a winhaj Job chi', yujto stek'b'ej sb'a winh yalani to malaj smul winh, syak'ankanb'at winh t'a yib'anh Dios.

Ix kot pax yowal winhaj Eliú chi' t'a oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi', yujto maj nachajel yuj heb' winh tas ix aj spakan slolonel winh heb' winh, wach'chom ix yak'kan heb' winh t'a yib'anh winh.
Ha winhaj Eliú chi' kelemto winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix stanhwej winh slolon juntzanhxo heb' winh chi' yet' winhaj Job chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh to maxtzak yal spakan heb' winh t'a winhaj Job chi', majxo techaj yuj winh syamanoch wa'an sb'a,
ix syamanoch winh yalan yik t'a skal heb' winh icha tik: Ha in tik kelem unin hinto, a exxo tik ichamtak winak exxo, yuj chi' maj yal in k'ol ix walb'at tas tzin na' t'a skal eyiko'.
Ix in na'an icha tik: Lolonokab' heb' winh ichamtak winak tik, yujto te ay tas yojtak heb' winh. Sch'oxokab'el sjelanil heb' winh chi', xin chi.
Palta jun, masanil anima aynhej spensar, yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix ak'anoch Yespíritu t'a heb'.
Manh yujok to niwanxo ab'il syil junok mach, yuj chi' jelan, manh yujok yicham winakil junok mach, yuj chi' wach' snachajel yuj.
Yuj chi' swal icha tik: Komonok tze maklej pax eyab' tastak wik ol wala', ay pax jab'ok tas tzin nib'ej swala'.
Ha in tik ix in maklej wab' tas ix eyala' yakb'an a ex tik wan he na'an tas tzeyutej he pakan t'a winh t'a jelanil.
Ix wilanpaxi to malaj junok ex ix yal he pakan t'a winh icha wal smojal.
Xeyalta'och he b'a jelanil, yujto maj yal eyu'uj. Anhej Dios ol pakan slolonel winh chi'.
Manhok t'ayin ix yal juntzanh lolonel winh, yuj chi' manh ol in pak t'a winh icha ix he k'ulej a ex tik.
Ha tikne'ik mamin Job, a heb' winh oxwanh tik, somchajnak heb' winh, max yal-laj spakan heb' winh tas ix ala'.
Palta a in tik manh ol in em numan, wach'chom a heb' winh tik manhxa tas wach' yalan heb' winh, maxtzak nachaj yuj heb' winh tas tz'aj spakani.
Palta ol wak'och in b'a t'a skal jun lolonel tik, ol walan tas nab'il wu'uj.
Tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swala', maxtzak yal in yamanoch wa'an in b'a yuj tas nab'il tik wu'uj.
Ijan wal tzin t'inhchaj yuj in lolonel chi' swab'i, icha nok' ak' tz'u'um b'ut'an yuj yal sat uwa.
Yowalil ol wala', ichato chi' ol b'o in k'o'ol, yowalil ol in pak a lolonel tik.
Ha t'ayin, manh ch'okch'okoklaj yilji anima, palta lajannhej heb' smasanil.
Wal yel, a in tik manh in b'eyb'alok to ay junok mach swik'cha'anh. K'inalok icha chi', tzam yak'och in yahelal Dios, haton b'ojinak in.
